correctness.rationale: Every ideal is uniquely (a,b) with 0<=b<=a<=n, and every membership query constrains only one coordinate by a threshold. Version spaces thus have four integer endpoint bounds (A,B,C,D) intersected with b<=a. Normalization A=max(A,C), D=min(D,B) preserves all pairs. A nonconstant row-one query ranges A<t<=B and row-two C<t<=D; each has both nonempty branches because normalized D<=B and A>=C. The minimax recursion F=max_query (1+min(F_zero,F_one)) follows from the complete binary shattered-tree definition, with singleton value zero; each branch reduces the number of feasible ideals so induction proves equality for *every* n, and at most (n+1)^4 states times 2n queries proves complexity. Independent memoized integer evaluation checked BOTH sides of ALL ten adjacent thresholds from n=0 through n=52, with n51 dimension 9 and n52 dimension 10; proof of monotonicity of dimension in n makes adjacent checks enough. Independently fetched the actual published depth10_n52_witness.json Git blob c12fee0d... and traversed 1023 internal nodes and all 1024 root-to-leaf paths verifying each imposes feasible ordered row bounds at n52. For VC dimension, any three cells contain two threshold-nested row queries and fail shattering, while (1,2),(2,1) are shattered at n>=2. Independent product threshold subfamily and class cardinality show 2log_2(n)+O(1). Finite certificate supports only depth-ten cutoff; full all-n recurrence comes from closure proof.

value.rationale: The two-row Young-diagram ideal concept class is the smallest nontrivial monotone staircase, a natural constrained product of online thresholds. Its exact polynomial-state adaptive-shattering rank, ten sharp integer cutoffs, and unbounded Littlestone-versus-bounded VC separation are interpretable learning-theoretic invariants, not arbitrary slices or routine VC bounds. A researcher can use the DP for exact online mistake limits of these structured classes.

final_claim: For all n>=0 the Littlestone dimension of order ideals of [2]x[n], encoded as two nested threshold row lengths, is computed exactly by the four-endpoint dynamic recurrence with O(n^4) states and O(n^5) time. Sharp minimum n for depths d=1..10 are 1,2,3,5,8,12,17,25,36,52; VC dimension is min(n,2) despite Littlestone dimension growing 2log_2(n)+O(1).
limitations: VC and Littlestone results are for membership concepts of two-row rectangular order ideals only, ordinary realizable adaptive online prediction; no closed expression for all depth cutoff values, no claims about higher row counts.
